method: Read the source of AI_PUZZLE_TRACK, AI_WHEEL (+ AI_WHEEL_COLOURS) and HEALTH_CHAT in both versions (not the bench, earlier fixtures, CHANGELOG or reports). Wrote 405 cases of my own, each answer worked out by hand before any run (cases_*.js in the scratchpad), then booted 1.24.19 and the 1.24.20 draft in Node + jsdom and ran every case on both, timing each. Rule 1: Lantern.aiTrack.run; an answer is compared on the row and/or every held thing; 'right' = the hand answer, or a problem where the lines are ambiguous or wrong (rightInput false); 'missed' = a right input sent back; 'spoiled' = a right input answered silently wrong; 'mended-wrong' = an ambiguous/wrong input answered silently instead of sent back; 'crash' = a JS error or a hang (any case over 2 s). Rule 3: Lantern.aiAct.build(MAKE WHEEL block, question); 'one part per colour' must give the colours as parts in that order, each inner wedge painted its own hue (checked from the shapes); a colour wheel left in its groups is 'missed', groups re-cut against a cut the question asks for is 'spoiled'. Rule 5: Lantern.healthLessons(q) keys; every question is a right input (a person's own question); a bite to a person without the Bites and stings lesson is 'missed', a non-bite handed the Bites lesson is 'spoiled'. newIn_1_24_20 = 1.24.20 is not right and is worse than 1.24.19 (right < missed < mended-wrong < spoiled < crash), or as bad with a different wrong answer. Also 7518 random inputs per version (3011 TRACK blocks of up to 8 lines from place words, names like Last/Left/Twice, repeat words and connectors, with hand-made worst cases: 300-name rows, 400 lines, 30-deep 'between', 60 'to's, 70 adds; 1501 wheels; 3006 bite questions incl. 9,000-50,000-character ones), timed: no crash, slowest TRACK 50 ms, wheel 9 ms, bite 172 ms. Then by hand: repeat words stacked on one line ('twice twice ...', '12 times 12 times ...') -- the one hang found (T188-T190).
